# Typed.js 2.1.0

Homepage typewriter animation uses the unmodified UMD distribution from:
https://github.com/mattboldt/typed.js/tree/v2.1.0

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mattboldt/typed.js/v2.1.0/dist/typed.umd.js
License: MIT; see LICENSE.txt in this directory.

This version is pinned and served locally. No runtime CDN or npm build is required.
